name: List Group Members
description: List all users in a User Group. [See the documentation](https://api.slack.com/methods/usergroups.users.list)

configurable_props.name: userGroup
configurable_props.label: User Group
configurable_props.description: The encoded ID of the User Group.

configurable_props.name: team
configurable_props.label: Team
configurable_props.description: Encoded team id where the user group exists, required if org token is used.

configurable_props.name: pageSize
configurable_props.label: Page Size
configurable_props.description: The number of results to include in a page. Default: 250

configurable_props.name: numPages
configurable_props.label: Number of Pages
configurable_props.description: The number of pages to retrieve. Default: 1
